description.value: Arriva Ristorante is a 42-year landmark on Vancouver's Commercial Drive, the city's historic 'Little Italy' district, where owner Paolo Frau serves entirely house-made Italian cuisine including scratch-made gnocchi, sausages, pancetta, breads, and desserts. It has become a destination restaurant drawing diners from across the region with an extensive Italian and international wine list. Commercial Drive itself is a major cycling corridor through east Vancouver, putting this long-established sit-down restaurant directly on common touring routes.
